overlay: schematic finger placement; only aperture is predicted, fingertip geometry is not learned
measurements: Marker center replaces index MCP; target auto-detected and locked at recording start, or manually overridden; no aperture ground truth measured
video_timing: Timestamp-resampled constant FPS using preceding captured frame; output 1920x1080 MJPEG AVI and native-resolution camera overlay AVI
weights: D1 defaults to fold_01 static-augmented LSTM with unchanged reference Function/MLP; 480 training trials; exact bundle and training_config.json record provenance
display_adjustment: Display and recorded image only; HSV detection uses original capture pixels
raw_video_processing: Original full captured camera pixels; no crop, display brightness adjustment, resizing, annotations or virtual fingers. MJPEG encoding; timestamp-resampled, not lossless sensor data.
